description: A 10 second clip that shows what the product does.
evaluationCriteria: The first frame is a real product view.
One action arc and one camera move.
Nothing the model draws reads as text, a logo or an interface; on-screen words are added after generation.
hookFormula: Open on the problem the buyer already feels, then show the product resolving it in one move.
label: Product explainer clip

shots.direction: The real product frame, held steady, with the pain visible.
shots.title: Problem

shots.direction: One camera move toward the part of the product that fixes it.
shots.title: Resolve

shots.direction: Settle on the finished state for a clean end frame.
shots.title: Payoff
